review_text_raw:
Is it a short game?
Yes...about 3-4 hours or less depending on your problem-solving skills.

Is it a hard puzzle/deduction game?
Somewhat.

Is it similar to other hacking game where you have to type command lines?
Not really...you'll mostly using your mouse with minimal typing required.

Does it have voice acting?
Yes...and really good ones.

Is it worth the price?
This game has all the action & suspense that Ice Cube's War Of The Worlds movie wished it had.
